question: Baisakhi is the festival of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Baisakhi is celebrated in the month of April every year in India.
 
• It marks the beginning of the harvest season for the rabi crops.
 
• This festival is also significant for Sikhs as it commemorates the formation of the Khalsa in 1699 by Guru Gobind Singh.
 
• It is celebrated with great enthusiasm, especially in the state of Punjab.
 
• People participate in processions, fairs, and perform the traditional Bhangra dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Baisakhi is also known as Vaisakhi in some regions.
 
• It is observed on 13th or 14th April each year.
 
• In addition to Punjab, Baisakhi is celebrated in various parts of India, including Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.
 
• It is considered an auspicious day for new beginnings and many people take a holy dip in rivers.
 
• In rural areas, it is a time for community gatherings and traditional sports.
